newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France holds intervention rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France holds intervention rate unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of France said on Monday it was leaving its intervention rate unchanged at 3.15 percent at a money market tender.
Economists had not expected a cut. The Bank of France monetary policy council next meets on January 30.
The Bank continued to post its five-to-10 day rate at 4.60 percent.

The intervention rate, at which the central bank allocates repo funds, was last cut -- from 3.20 percent -- on December 17, 1996. The Bank cut 15 basis points off its five-to-10 day rate, from 4.75 percent, the same day.
